Subject: RE: Post-call recap + MAP draft: Acme POC environment setup (technical details)

Hi Alicia, Marissa —

Quick technical notes and what we'll need from Acme to progress the POC environment milestone:

1) VPC peering / Networking
- Required from Acme: CIDR ranges for VPCs, preferred peering window (dates/times), and whether peering will be cross-account.
- Redwood action: we will provide our side of the peering config and testing plan.
- Dependency: Firewall rules on your side to allow management traffic (TCP 443, 5222 for agents if used).

2) IP allowlists
- We can provide a static set of egress IP ranges for the POC (preferred) or allowlist by FQDN if your infra supports it.
- Attached: network-diagram.png showing expected flows for the POC.

3) SSO / SAML
- We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated, but SP-initiated is our recommended flow for test users.
- What we need: SAML metadata XML, ACS URL acceptance, and a test user.

4) Secrets / KMS
- If Acme uses a customer-managed KMS key we need an IAM role with Decrypt permissions scoped to the key for the Redwood service principal; alternatively, Redwood-managed secrets are possible for the POC (less secure for regulated data).

Acceptance criteria for the POC environment milestone:
- VPC peering established and verified by successful health checks.
- Successful SSO login for two test users.
- Secrets retrieval from KMS or Redwood-managed secrets verified.
- Traffic flows validated from a sample workload with <100ms median token latency (example metric).

I can take the first technical sync next week — propose Wed 2026-03-18 10:00 PT. Let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
